info.title: Talai middleware
info.description: The only component allowed to talk to TallyPrime. Every route under /api/v1 requires a bearer token; /health does not.

post.description: Probe a host/port without saving it — used by the Configuration page.

put.description: ``TALLY_WRITE_ENABLED`` is deliberately not settable over HTTP (plan §6).

Unknown group names are reported in ``warnings``, never rejected: the
replica may simply not have been pulled yet.

post.description:
Create a Sundry Creditors ledger in Tally (plan §3.8.4).

With ``TALLY_WRITE_ENABLED=false`` nothing is sent: the generated envelope
comes back so it can be reviewed, exactly like a dry-run push.

get.description: Exact match plus near-matches under Sundry Creditors (plan §3.8.1).

post.description: Store the file (random name, plan §6) and queue OCR for it.
Read the file again, synchronously, and replace the stored result.

post.summary: Create a draft from the OCR result

AttachmentOut.title: AttachmentOut
AttachmentOut.description: An uploaded bill file and what OCR made of it (plan §3.10).

DashboardFormula-Input.title: DashboardFormula
DashboardFormula-Input.description:
How the dashboard computes gross profit (plan §3.9).

``simple``  — cost of sales = Σ ``cost_of_sales_groups`` for the period.
``trading`` — cost of sales = opening stock + Σ groups − closing stock.

DashboardFormula-Output.title: DashboardFormula
DashboardFormula-Output.description:
How the dashboard computes gross profit (plan §3.9).

``simple``  — cost of sales = Σ ``cost_of_sales_groups`` for the period.
``trading`` — cost of sales = opening stock + Σ groups − closing stock.

DashboardFormulaOut.title: DashboardFormulaOut
DashboardFormulaOut.description:
The stored formula plus any non-blocking complaints about it.

``warnings`` is additive to §3.9: a group name that is not in the replica
is reported but never rejected, because the replica may simply be stale.
